tool.name: RiboHub: Generate Gwips Track Hub
tool.description: Build a Gwips RiboSeq track hub from bigWig and bigBed files
tool.command:
ribohub generate #if $samples --samples '$samples' #end if --output-dir './hub_output' --output-format 'single-file' --genome '$genome'
## Metadata: use server default from env, or skip if not configured #if $RIBOHUB_METADATA --metadata '$RIBOHUB_METADATA' #end if
## Track selection #set $kind_list = [] #if $kinds.kind_all #silent $kind_list.append("all") #end if #if $kinds.kind_unique #silent $kind_list.append("unique") #end if #if $kinds.kind_multi #silent $kind_list.append("multi") #end if #if $kind_list --kinds '${",".join($kind_list)}' #end if
#if $with_aggregates --with-aggregates #else --no-aggregates #end if
#if $with_regions --with-regions #else --no-regions #end if
## Metadata filter #if $metadata_filter --filter '$metadata_filter' #end if
## Hub name #if $hub_name --hub-name '$hub_name' #end if
## Colors #if str($colors.color_fwd) != "#E69F00" --color-fwd '$colors.color_fwd' #end if #if str($colors.color_rev) != "#0072B2" --color-rev '$colors.color_rev' #end if #if str($colors.color_fwd_multi) != "#F0C566" --color-fwd-multi '$colors.color_fwd_multi' #end if #if str($colors.color_rev_multi) != "#56B4E9" --color-rev-multi '$colors.color_rev_multi' #end if
$dry_run
## Copy output to Galaxy history #if not $dry_run #set $hub_name_val = $hub_name if $hub_name else "RiboSeqHub" && cp './hub_output/${hub_name_val}.hub.txt' '$hub_output' #end if

param.name: samples
param.label: Sample list
param.help: CSV (first column = SRR IDs) or plain text (one SRR per line). Optional if using a metadata filter below.

param.name: metadata_filter
param.label: Filter samples from metadata (optional)
param.help: Select samples by metadata column values instead of (or alongside) a sample list. Format: COL=VAL or COL=VAL1|VAL2 (OR within a field), comma-separated (AND across fields). Example: CONDITION=High|Test,CELL_LINE=HEK293. Available columns: ScientificName, LIBRARYTYPE, TISSUE, CELL_LINE, CONDITION, INHIBITOR, TIMEPOINT, REPLICATE.

param.name: with_aggregates
param.label: Include strand overlays
param.help: Per-sample transparent overlay of forward + reverse strands. Recommended for quick visual comparison.

param.name: with_regions
param.label: Include region annotations
param.help: Include bigBed region tracks (e.g. ORFs) if available for the sample.

param.name: hub_name
param.label: Hub name (optional)
param.help: Default: RiboSeqHub. Used as the filename and Gwips hub identifier. No spaces.

param.name: color_fwd
param.label: Forward strand
param.help: Hex color for forward strand tracks.

param.name: color_rev
param.label: Reverse strand
param.help: Hex color for reverse strand tracks.

param.name: color_fwd_multi
param.label: Forward multimapped
param.help: Hex color for forward multimapped tracks.

param.name: color_rev_multi
param.label: Reverse multimapped
param.help: Hex color for reverse multimapped tracks.

param.name: dry_run
param.label: Dry run
param.help: Preview what would be built without writing any files. Useful for checking sample counts before a long build.

tool.help:
**RiboHub: Generate Gwips Track Hub**
Builds a Gwips Genome Browser track hub from sorted bigWig files produced by the RiboSeqOrg pipeline. Designed for use with GWIPS-viz and RiboGalaxy.
-----
**What you need**
Upload a sample list, a CSV with SRR IDs in the first column or a plain text file with one SRR per line. Alternatively, use the metadata filter to select samples by their properties (e.g. cell line, condition, tissue) without needing a file. You can also combine both: upload a sample list and apply a filter to narrow it further.
The server already knows where the bigWig files live and how to serve them to Gwips.
-----
**Track types**
- *Strand overlays* = forward and reverse strands rendered as a transparent overlay per sample. Best for quick visual inspection. - *Region annotations* = bigBed tracks (e.g. ORFs) displayed alongside signal, if available for your samples. - *Read types* = choose which signal to include: all reads (combined), uniquely mapped only or multimapped only. All three are on by default.
-----
**Customization**
- *Hub name* = change the Gwips hub identifier (default: RiboSeqHub). - *Strand colors* = set custom hex colors under "Strand colors". Defaults are Okabe-Ito colorblind-safe: orange forward, blue reverse.
-----
**Dry run**
Enable "Dry run" to see how many samples were found and matched metadata without building anything. Useful for large sample sets.
-----
**Metadata filter examples**
- ``CELL_LINE=HEK293`` = all HEK293 samples - ``CONDITION=High|Test`` = samples where condition is High OR Test - ``CELL_LINE=HEK293,CONDITION=High`` = HEK293 AND High condition - ``TISSUE=Kidney,LIBRARYTYPE=Ribo-Seq`` = kidney tissue Ribo-Seq samples
